about: The feature examples, in the order the app lists them: each is a structure file in this folder and the settings that show its feature, applied when it is opened from the list. Opening the same file by hand gives the plain defaults.

examples.title: Distortion mode
examples.note: SrTiO3 below 105 K: one layer of TiO6 octahedra, turned about c (mode R4+), seen down c

examples.title: Orbitals
examples.note: A TiO6 octahedron of SrTiO3, the two eg orbitals of Ti pointing at O

examples.title: RMC configuration, folded
examples.note: A 6 x 6 x 6 SrTiO3 configuration folded into one averaged cell
